{"consolidated_memory":"DOUBLE COUNTING IN ANALYTICS/ETL/ROLLUP.SQL — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: analytics/etl/rollup.sql (analytics side)
Problem Type: Double counting in the daily rollup
Common Signal: Totals larger than the source table
Common Repro: Rerun the rollup for a day already loaded

---

OCCASION 1: 2026-02-17
Trigger Condition: Problem appeared only when the input list came in empty
Root Cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR: #8102 on branch fix/double-counting-2
Measured Outcome: 89 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

---

OCCASION 2: 2026-08-17
Trigger Condition: Problem appeared only for records carrying non-ASCII names
Root Cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR: #9706 on branch fix/double-counting-3
Measured Outcome: Flaky test went from 41 failures per hundred runs to zero

Both incidents involved the same file and symptom but had distinct root causes (timing vs. resource exhaustion) and different trigger conditions (empty input list vs. non-ASCII names)."}
